content: Self-hosted agent-fleet-manager space in 2026 is fragmented and mostly early-stage/niche OSS projects (visual DAG builders, multi-framework adapters for CrewAI/LangGraph/AutoGen-style stacks) rather than a dominant standard tool; most emphasize multi-agent workflow orchestration and cost tracking rather than the single-user single-repo-per-task review loop Fleet targets. Treat specific project names in this space as low-confidence/unverified.
